title: Sharp Geometric-Horizon Parameterization, Exact Pairwise Fredman Extremality, and Zero-O(.) Comparison Certificates for Deterministic Linear-Time Minimum Spanning Trees
abstract: In a landmark result of November 2026, Khanna, Putterman, and Song proved that the deterministic comparison complexity of the minimum spanning tree (MST) problem is linear, T*(m, n) = O(m), using a recursive portal-spoke certificate procedure with polynomial depth schedule t_d = gamma d^3, r_d = 8 t_d^3 that hides all multiplicative constants inside asymptotic O_eps(.) notation. We establish three sharp, zero-O(.) structural theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems and 16 zero-float rational certificates. First, we sharpen three combinatorial primitives: the exact maximum bad-round count in any t x t monotone block schedule is strictly 2t - 1 (attained for all t >= 1), greedy portal covering obeys |P'| <= (2r^2 - 2r + 1)/r^3 * n < 2n/r, and the exact pairwise maxima-vector maximum is M(n, 2) = floor((n^2 + n + 2)/3) for all n >= 3, strictly below Fredman's binomial ceiling C(n+1, 2) by an asymptotic factor of 2/3. Second, we expose a hidden factorial polylogarithmic blowup in polynomial schedules (sum d^21/4^(d-1) > 1.547e17, sum (d-1)d^19.5/2^(d-1) > 5.662e22, forcing C_{1/8}^KPS > 7.882e33 and k_Bor >= 230) and prove that a geometric-horizon schedule t_d = ceil(gamma rho^(d-1)), r_d = 2 kappa t_d^3 is jointly stable if and only if 1 < rho < kappa^(1/13). Third, at (theta, eps, kappa, rho, gamma) = (1/2, 7/16, 32, 13/10, 80), we certify a > 4.779e16x reduction in C_eps (to < 1.650e17), save 106 Boruvka phases (230 -> 124), establish an explicit zero-O(.) comparison bound T*(m, n) <= 944 m (including a base-case-free T_PICK(N) <= 23 N proof for all N >= 1 and Komlos's non-asymptotic directed verification theorem), and certify end-to-end exact Boruvka, portal-spoke, and cycle-support filtering invariance on canonical graphs.
